kindNotes: hud.event-chips: the root has no data-frame (a container: its own border and the 8 px gap)

hud.status-pill.data: seed 1 stone town: date, population, food, coin

hud.steward-bubble.data: the steward's line (quiet, or the advisor's line when he speaks)

hud.event-card.lord-moment.data: the lord's suit filed: its Wave 40 picture and the ledger's sentence

hud.goal-help.data: a tutorial goal card's help line
hud.goal-help.unreachable: the help seal shows only on a tutorial card whose step has an advisor line; the opening card, the one after it and the chapter goal cards (tutorial off) carry none, and later steps need buildings finished (UI-AUDIT-1 smoke runs)

slot.goals.data: the goal log, the settlement line and its progress

slot.ledger.steward.data: the stone town's stocks with the steward's advice open

slot.ledger.steward-concern.data: the famine's alerts with the steward's warning open

slot.ledger.rights.data: chapter 4's rights register (charter rights, fee farm, revolt pressure)

slot.ledger.rights-decline.data: chapter 2's register after a right is lost

slot.ledger.wage.data: chapter 3's wage ledger under the stocks

modal.year-review.data: 1302's card at 1303's first tick: its decisions (or none), the factions' moves, the town's people and money

modal.famine.data: chapter 1's famine decision (DEC-CARD: four answers, the steward beside the stake)

modal.petition.heir.data: the heir's card with three candidates

modal.lord.home-petition.data: the boundary dispute (Wave 44 01) in the DEC-CARD layout: the situation, the stake, each answer now / later / who remembers

modal.lord.home-petition.guardian.data: a minor lord's wardship petition (the court line with his guardian)

modal.lord.request.data: the town's request (a proclamation waiting) in the DEC-CARD layout: the grant's now (the works it opens) and later (the actual's day)

modal.house-change.wardship.data: a minor lord's wardship begun (Wave 40 13): who, the guardian, no right changed, his card as the next act — before the boundary dispute's card

modal.house-change.lord-died.data: the lord's death (no picture): his name and age, who leads the house now

modal.house-change.inherited.data: the neighbour's estate inherited (Wave 40 08): the old lord's death, the title and possession, five debts promised, the estates screen as the next act

modal.lord.registry.data: the first v4 offer the registry drew in the lord's slice (DEC-CARD layout): its why, each answer's tradeoff, now / later / who remembers, the shut one with why

modal.lord.registry-hold.data: the first v4 offer with a hold the lord can choose (DEC-CARD layout): the hold's cost as the engine's run shows it (the claim weakened)

slot.ledger.lord.data: the lord tab: the four policies (stability), the 10d farmstead subsidy, the draft and the dues at 80%

slot.ledger.lord-refusal.data: a subsidy draft past a quarter of the treasury: the reason written, the set button shut

slot.ledger.stock-lord.data: the lord's slice stock tab: the treasury by estate under the treasury line, then the stocks

slot.ledger.lord-open.data: the ledger's lord tab with the way into the lord screens above the policies

lord.negotiation.draft.data: the marriage offer before any is sent: the grooms, the clause editor, the draft treaty (consent alone), the counterpart's tier and reasons, the refusal (no terms) under a shut offer button

lord.negotiation.counter.data: the counterpart's counter waiting a season: the clauses with the one it added marked, its tier and reasons, the deadline and what silence means, each answer's now / later / who remembers (DEC-CARD), accept and refuse as equal choices

lord.negotiation.will-change.data: the marriage's progress with the will change due: the events as they fell, the deferred debt, the contract's clauses under a stamped seal

lord.negotiation.contested.data: the estate contested after the will stood: the rival named, the outcome, the way to its suit on the ledger screen

slot.ledger.lord-policy-subsidy.data: the ledger's lord tab with a subsidy on offer: the four policies with their icons, the subsidy's notice and its row

modal.lord.will-change.data: the father's new will: favour (shut when the treasury is short), support promised (its promise, stake and witnesses), let it stand (the rival's claim) — the engine's run

modal.lord.contested.data: the contested inheritance: the rival's hold, both claims' strength, the lord's suit stage, the way to the suit

modal.lord.audit.data: a Michaelmas audit's finding: punish, replace, tolerate — what each recovers, who follows, who remembers

modal.lord.offmap-petition.data: an off-map estate's petition: why it came to the lord, both answers' treasury and the estate's goodwill
